name: Helideck
description: The read sources treat a helipad/helideck as an appurtenance: an NUI is described as little more than a well bay, helipad and emergency shelter; US4679964A describes a cantilevered helideck on single- or multi-well conductor-supported configurations; US4932811A describes an upper heliport deck carried by piles around a caisson. No page read in this sweep stated a helideck D-value, load classification, obstacle-free sector or a visit-frequency rule, and the CAP 437 PDF was refused.
aliases: Helideck (only on platforms with regular crewed visits)
